title: Laguna Seca Will Rename the Corkscrew After Alex Zanardi

body_markdown:
Thirty years ago, the late Alex Zanardi did the seemingly impossible at Laguna Seca’s most famous corner during the final race of the 1996 CART season. After race officials waved the white flag, Zanardi, who had been trailing race leader Bryan Herta for some time, flung his Honda-powered Reynard down the inside of the Corkscrew, passing Herta and securing the third win of his impressive rookie season.


That move, since immortalized as “The Pass,” remains one of the most recognizable in motorsports history. The man behind it will soon be immortalized at the corner where he pulled it off. This Friday, WeatherTech Raceway Laguna Seca will rename its famous two-part corner as the “Zanardi Corkscrew” to honor the Italian driver with an indomitable spirit.


Getty Images


“I met Alex in his rookie IndyCar year with Chip \[Ganassi\],” said[Bruce Canepa](https://www.hagerty.com/media/people/talking-porsches-with-bruce-canepa/) . “We will always remember his fearless racing style, his determination and, perhaps most of all, that infectious smile that made him so beloved throughout the motorsports community.”


Zanardi’s last-lap pass was a perfect encapsulation of his driving style—bold, exacting, and full of flair. After winning rookie of the year in the 1996 season, Zanardi secured the championship in each of the following two seasons with Chip Ganassi’s team. Ganassi is one of several series stalwarts who will be in attendance on Friday morning.


Jamie Squire/Getty Images


Needless to say, we’re in full support of this move. Zanardi, who passed away this May, was a hero in the truest sense of the word. He was the embodiment of an unbreakable spirit whether in his early CART days, in the years following the tragic 2001 crash in which he lost both of his legs, or in his later years competing in the Paralympics. Our own Steven Cole Smith penned an incredibly touching tribute to Zanardi, which is[absolutely worth your time to revisit](https://www.hagerty.com/media/motorsports/remembering-alex-zanardi/) .


IndyCar is racing at[Laguna Seca](https://www.hagerty.com/media/opinion/laguna-seca-lawsuit-homeowners-perplexed-as-iconic-race-track-materializes-overnight/) this weekend. The Corkscrew, which drops six stories in just 450 feet of asphalt, will be on full display. As fans watch the Dallara cars go hurtling through this roller coaster, we’d bet more than a few of them will be daydreaming about a certain Target-branded car pulling off an overtake for the ages.
